title: OrderDesk: email, PDF and WhatsApp orders turned into draft orders for small wholesalers
source: Top 25 SaaS ideas for Victor (research report, Nov 2026)
summary: Turns order and quote-request emails, PDFs and WhatsApp messages into draft orders matched to the wholesaler's own product list, ready to approve.
hook: "Two people in my office do nothing all morning but type orders from emails and WhatsApp into Fortnox."
story:
**Erik owns a building-materials wholesaler in Sweden with 12 staff.** Customers order by email, PDF purchase orders and WhatsApp messages like "same as last time but 20 more of the grey ones". Two office staff type every order into the accounting system by hand, matching vague product names to codes.

Mistakes cost money: wrong products shipped, wrong prices invoiced. AI order-entry tools exist, but they are built for big distributors on Epicor, NetSuite or SAP. With OrderDesk, every order goes to one inbound address, AI pulls out **customer, lines, quantities and dates**, matches them to Erik's **product list**, and his staff just **review and approve** before it goes to Fortnox.
whyNow: AI order entry is moving into distribution, but for big companies: Proton.ai launched AI order and quote entry in July 2026, and trade press wrote in September 2026 that "AI moves into the distributor order desk". Small distributors on small accounting systems are left out.
evidence: More than 30% of wholesale orders arrive through unstructured channels and manual entry takes about 6 minutes per order (vendor figures) [Workd]
A distributor with 200 orders a day spends about $130k a year on manual order entry (vendor figure) [Workd]
Proton.ai launched AI order and quote entry for distributors in July 2026 [Distribution Strategy]
"AI moves into the distributor order desk as new tools target manual work" (September 2026) [Distribution Strategy]
Nexcade's reported $6M seed round for AI freight-forwarder agents confirms quote-request emails are a real pain [The Loadstar]

whyReal.title: Manual entry is expensive

whyReal.title: Big vendors are moving in, at the top
whyReal.text: Proton.ai, Y Meadows, WizCommerce and others target mid-market ERPs like Epicor, P21, NetSuite and SAP.

whyReal.title: Small systems are left out
whyReal.text: Fortnox, Visma, Odoo, SmartBill and Excel users in the Nordics, Eastern Europe and the UK have no self-serve option.

whyReal.title: Two networks to test in
whyReal.text: Jonatan reaches Swedish wholesalers; Victor knows Romanian and Moldovan wholesalers as a test bed.

whoPays.label: Customer
whoPays.text: Wholesalers and distributors with 3–50 staff (food, building materials, industrial supplies, farm inputs) that receive 20–200 orders a day by email, PDF or WhatsApp. Later: small road forwarders and CNC job shops with quote requests.

whoPays.label: Start market
whoPays.text: Sweden (Fortnox first) and Romania/Moldova, then the UK and other Nordic/CEE countries.

solution.title: One inbound address
solution.text: customers keep ordering the way they do; orders are forwarded to a dedicated email address.

solution.title: AI extracts the order
solution.text: customer, order lines, quantities and dates from emails, PDFs and messages.

solution.title: Match to the product list
solution.text: fuzzy matching of product names to the wholesaler's uploaded product CSV.

solution.title: Review screen
solution.text: staff check and fix the draft order in seconds.

solution.title: Export
solution.text: to CSV or one accounting API (Fortnox first).

solution.title: Confirm to the customer
solution.text: an automatic confirmation email goes back.

must: AI extraction of customer, lines, quantities and dates
Fuzzy matching of product names to an uploaded product CSV
Export to CSV or the Fortnox API
Confirmation email back to the customer
later: Quote-request mode for road forwarders and job shops

techStack: LLM extraction + fuzzy matching (e.g. trigram / embeddings)

timeline.what: **Validate, no code.** Find 10 Swedish or Romanian wholesalers; ask for 50 real past order emails; run them through an LLM by hand; show the accuracy and time saved. Target 2 letters of intent.
Victor builds inbound email, AI extraction, product matching and the review screen.
CSV and Fortnox export, confirmation emails, billing; tune accuracy on real orders.
Pilots run live order volume; add WhatsApp if customers ask.

costs.note: Small EU cloud server or Vercel/Supabase free tiers + transactional email (report estimate)
Carrd / Typeform / Google Forms for the no-code test
Report estimate, not a price quote
